brief.headline: Cut the measuring-cup price to ₹0.35/NOS (Premier's level) and move payment to 30 days to free up ₹10.19 L cash for us.

priceAsk.summary: Reduce the measuring-cup price from ₹0.38/NOS to ₹0.35/NOS
priceAsk.basis: Premier Plastic supplies the same cup at ₹0.35/NOS, an 8.6% lower price. The open market shows modest room to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume for similar caps, so ₹0.35 is achievable and fair.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days after receipt to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹10.19 L cash freed up for us

brief.financialLeverage: Mars Plastics publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or cash position. Our ₹1.24 Cr annual spend is material for a private converter, but without their numbers we must lean on our purchase data and the credible second sources we have lined up. We have five robust alternates — including Manjushree (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter) and three listed firms — so we can push firmly on price and payment without losing supply security.

evidence.point: Premier Plastic gives us the same measuring cup 8.6% cheaper
Closing that gap saves us ₹82500 every year
Moving payment from 45 days to 30 days frees up over ten lakh cash for us
The open market for similar PP caps is ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
evidence.figure: 28 mm induction-wad PP cap ask band ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc; verdict MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80

evidence.point: Our annual spend with them is ₹1.24 Cr — meaningful volume for a private converter
evidence.figure: ₹1.24 Cr FDC annual spend with them

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue) specializing in pharma bottles, caps and preforms — the top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers and pharma packaging — strong, profitable and a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd
alternates.why: Listed PET bottle and jar specialist (Pearlpet brand) — direct fit for PET bottles

risks: Mars Plastics does not publish financials, so we can't see early-warning signs of cash trouble or capacity issues — qualify Manjushree or Mold-Tek now so we have an approved second source before pushing hard.
If Mars resists both asks, split the negotiation: lock the price cut first (it's justified by Premier's ₹0.35), then trade faster payment for a smaller additional discount.
The market-ask data is for a 28 mm cap, not our exact measuring-cup SKU — use it to show the direction (modest room exists) but anchor the target on Premier's real ₹0.35/NOS price.
Three of the six market backup leads (Srichakra, Dalmia, Ganesha) are recyclers, not primary manufacturers — verify their quality and pharma certifications before sending an RFQ.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the 8.6% gap on the measuring cup — Premier delivers the same part at ₹0.35, and we want to align you to that price while moving to 30-day payment to free up cash for both of us.
